title: Employ staff under the Corrections and Detention (Private Sector) Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Corrections and Detention (Private Sector) Award 2020.

sources.title: Corrections and Detention (Private Sector) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the corrections and detention industry and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 12 — Classifications to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.condition: private operation of correctional and detention facilities (cl 4.2)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Corrections and Detention (Private Sector) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award, the corrections and detention industry means the private operation of correctional facilities

sources.title: Corrections and Detention (Private Sector) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award, the corrections and detention industry means the private operation of correctional facilities, custody centres, court custody services and detention facilities, and the private operation of prisoner or detainee facilities or services, including the provision of security escort services to and from correctional facilities, courts and/or hospitals carried out by private operators. [4.3 varied by PR743462 ppc 11Jul22]

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Corrections and Detention (Private Sector) Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 12 Nov 2026 from the award's coverage clause, not yet checked.
